module: Event node "On Vehicle Destroyed" (category `logic`, tag event). Emits a pulse on `flow` and the `vehId` of the destroyed vehicle when the `onVehicleDestroyed` hook is received. Input pin: `flow`.

C.desc: Flowgraph node class (returned by `_flowgraph_createNode(C)`). Definition fields: name, description, category, pinSchema, tags.

_afterTrigger.desc: Called by the manager after the node is triggered; resets the event flag to false.

_executionStarted.desc: Called by the manager when the flowgraph project execution starts; resets the internal state to zero.

onVehicleDestroyed.desc: Hook called when a vehicle is destroyed; stores `id` and raises the flag.

work.desc: If the flag is raised, sets `vehId` and `flow` to true for one frame, otherwise `flow` to false.
